lines: 我要自由而行，因我素来考究你的训词。
我要自由而行，因我素來考究你的訓詞。
I will walk in liberty
for I have sought your precepts.
我要自由而行，因我素来考究你的训词。
我要自由而行，因我素來考究你的訓詞。
I will walk in liberty
for I have sought your precepts.
So that my way may be in a wide place: because my search has been for your orders.
我也要在君王面前论说你的法度，
并不至于羞愧。
我也要在君王面前論說你的法度，
並不至於羞愧。
I will also speak of your statutes before kings
and will not be disappointed.
我也要在君王面前论说你的法度，
并不至于羞愧。
我也要在君王面前論說你的法度，
並不至於羞愧。
I will also speak of your statutes before kings
and will not be disappointed.
So that I may give knowledge of your unchanging word before kings
and not be put to shame.
我要在你的命令中自乐；
这命令素来是我所爱的。
我要在你的命令中自樂；
這命令素來是我所愛的。
I will delight myself in your commandments
because I love them.
我要在你的命令中自乐；
这命令素来是我所爱的。
我要在你的命令中自樂；
這命令素來是我所愛的。
I will delight myself in your commandments
because I love them.
And so that I may take delight in your teachings
to which I have given my love.
我又要遵行你的命令，
这命令素来是我所爱的；
我也要思想你的律例。
我又要遵行你的命令，
這命令素來是我所愛的；
我也要思想你的律例。
I reach out my hands for your commandments
which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
我又要遵行你的命令，
这命令素来是我所爱的；
我也要思想你的律例。
我又要遵行你的命令，
這命令素來是我所愛的；
我也要思想你的律例。
I reach out my hands for your commandments
which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
And so that my hands may be stretched out to you; and I will give thought to your rules.
求你记念向你仆人所应许的话，
叫我有盼望。
求你記念向你僕人所應許的話，
叫我有盼望。
Remember your word to your servant
because you gave me hope.
求你记念向你仆人所应许的话，
叫我有盼望。
求你記念向你僕人所應許的話，
叫我有盼望。
Remember your word to your servant
because you gave me hope.
Keep in mind your word to your servant
for on it has my hope been fixed.
这话将我救活了；我在患难中，
因此得安慰。
這話將我救活了；我在患難中，
因此得安慰。
This is my comfort in my affliction
for your word has revived me.
这话将我救活了；我在患难中，
因此得安慰。
這話將我救活了；我在患難中，
因此得安慰。
This is my comfort in my affliction
for your word has revived me.
This is my comfort in my trouble; that your sayings have given me life.
骄傲的人甚侮慢我，
我却未曾偏离你的律法。
驕傲的人甚侮慢我，
我卻未曾偏離你的律法。
The arrogant mock me excessively
but I don’t swerve from your law.
骄傲的人甚侮慢我，
我却未曾偏离你的律法。
驕傲的人甚侮慢我，
我卻未曾偏離你的律法。
The arrogant mock me excessively
but I don’t swerve from your law.
The men of pride have made great sport of me; but I have not been turned from your law.
我在世寄居，素来以你的律例为诗歌。
我在世寄居，素來以你的律例為詩歌。
Your statutes have been my songs
in the house where I live.
我在世寄居，素来以你的律例为诗歌。
我在世寄居，素來以你的律例為詩歌。
Your statutes have been my songs
in the house where I live.
Your rules have been melodies to me
while I have been living in strange lands.
耶和华啊，我夜间记念你的名，
遵守你的律法。
耶和華啊，我夜間記念你的名，
遵守你的律法。
I have remembered your name
Yahweh
in the night
and I obey your law.
耶和华啊，我夜间记念你的名，
遵守你的律法。
耶和華啊，我夜間記念你的名，
遵守你的律法。
I have remembered your name
Yahweh
in the night
and I obey your law.
I have given thought to your name in the night
O Lord
and have kept your law.
耶和华是我的福分；
我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。
耶和華是我的福分；
我曾說，我要遵守你的言語。
Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
耶和华是我的福分；
我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。
耶和華是我的福分；
我曾說，我要遵守你的言語。
Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
The Lord is my heritage: I have said that I would be ruled by your words.
我一心求过你的恩；
愿你照你的话怜悯我！
我一心求過你的恩；
願你照你的話憐憫我！
I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
我一心求过你的恩；
愿你照你的话怜悯我！
我一心求過你的恩；
願你照你的話憐憫我！
I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
I have given my mind to do your pleasure with all my heart; have mercy on me
as you have said.
我思想我所行的道，
就转步归向你的法度。
我思想我所行的道，
就轉步歸向你的法度。
I considered my ways
and turned my steps to your statutes.
我思想我所行的道，
就转步归向你的法度。
我思想我所行的道，
就轉步歸向你的法度。
I considered my ways
and turned my steps to your statutes.
I gave thought to my steps
and my feet were turned into the way of your unchanging word.
我急忙遵守你的命令，
并不迟延。
我急忙遵守你的命令，
並不遲延。
I will hurry
and not delay
to obey your commandments.
我急忙遵守你的命令，
并不迟延。
我急忙遵守你的命令，
並不遲延。
I will hurry
and not delay
to obey your commandments.
I was quick to do your orders
and let no time be wasted.
恶人的绳索缠绕我，
我却没有忘记你的律法。
惡人的繩索纏繞我，
我卻沒有忘記你的律法。
The ropes of the wicked bind me
but I won’t forget your law.
恶人的绳索缠绕我，
我却没有忘记你的律法。
惡人的繩索纏繞我，
我卻沒有忘記你的律法。
The ropes of the wicked bind me
but I won’t forget your law.
The cords of evil-doers are round me; but I have kept in mind your law.
我因你公义的典章，
半夜必起来称谢你。
我因你公義的典章，
半夜必起來稱謝你。
At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you
because of your righteous ordinances.
我因你公义的典章，
半夜必起来称谢你。
我因你公義的典章，
半夜必起來稱謝你。
At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you
because of your righteous ordinances.
In the middle of the night I will get up to give you praise
because of all your right decisions.
凡敬畏你、守你训词的人，
我都与他作伴。
凡敬畏你、守你訓詞的人，
我都與他作伴。
I am a friend of all those who fear you
of those who observe your precepts.
凡敬畏你、守你训词的人，
我都与他作伴。
凡敬畏你、守你訓詞的人，
我都與他作伴。
I am a friend of all those who fear you
of those who observe your precepts.
I keep company with all your worshippers
and those who have your orders in their memory.
耶和华啊，你的慈爱遍满大地；
求你将你的律例教训我！
耶和華啊，你的慈愛遍滿大地；
求你將你的律例教訓我！
The earth is full of your loving kindness
Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
耶和华啊，你的慈爱遍满大地；
求你将你的律例教训我！
耶和華啊，你的慈愛遍滿大地；
求你將你的律例教訓我！
The earth is full of your loving kindness
Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
The earth
O Lord
is full of your mercy: give me knowledge of your rules.
耶和华啊，你向来是照你的话善待仆人。
耶和華啊，你向來是照你的話善待僕人。
Do good to your servant
according to your word
Yahweh.
耶和华啊，你向来是照你的话善待仆人。
耶和華啊，你向來是照你的話善待僕人。
Do good to your servant
according to your word
Yahweh.
You have done good to your servant
O Lord
in keeping with your word.
求你将精明和知识赐给我，
因我信了你的命令。
求你將精明和知識賜給我，
因我信了你的命令。
Teach me good judgment and knowledge
for I believe in your commandments.
求你将精明和知识赐给我，
因我信了你的命令。
求你將精明和知識賜給我，
因我信了你的命令。
Teach me good judgment and knowledge
for I believe in your commandments.
Give me knowledge and good sense; for I have put my faith in your teachings.
我未受苦以先走迷了路，
现在却遵守你的话。
我未受苦以先走迷了路，
現在卻遵守你的話。
Before I was afflicted
I went astray; but now I observe your word.
我未受苦以先走迷了路，
现在却遵守你的话。
我未受苦以先走迷了路，
現在卻遵守你的話。
Before I was afflicted
I went astray; but now I observe your word.
Before I was in trouble I went out of the way; but now I keep your word.
